meta.description: FileMaker calculation function catalog. Prototype signatures are canonical from the source repository. Category, slug, doc_url and purpose are sourced from the Claris Help Centre index.
meta.last_updated: 2026-06 (v1.9 — GetRecordIDsFromFoundSet FM 26 optional second parameter; GetTextFromPDF FM 26 scanned-PDF note; total 368)
meta.update_instructions: Re-fetch source repo and compare against this file. Also re-fetch each category_page from help.claris.com to pick up new functions or updated slugs. For new functions, check the FileMaker Pro Release Notes at https://help.claris.com/en/pro-release-notes/content/ to determine the version introduced.
meta.verification_method: Every entry re-derived from its live help.claris.com markdown page (## Format, ## Data type returned, ## Originated in version). Roster determined structurally, not from topic_type — Claris mislabels getpersistentdata, listpersistentdataids and get-systemstorageavailable as topic_type: conceptual.
meta.return_type_source: Claris '## Data type returned' section, all 368 pages
meta.fm26_notes: Google Gemini is supported as an AI model provider for text generation (FM 26). AI provider support changes frequently — always fetch the live page for the current provider list.

functions.name: Get(PersistentID)
functions.notes: Returns a unique, unchanging 32-digit hexadecimal identifier for the computer or device running FileMaker Pro, Go, Server, Cloud, or the current WebDirect session. Clearing browser cookies during a WebDirect session changes the value. Restoring an iOS backup to a DIFFERENT device changes it; restoring to the same device does not. Unrelated to the FM 26 persistent data store despite the similar name.
